The '''seventh Duro Relocation Colony''' was an effort by the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] to settle other [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. They settled [[Pii III]] but eventually abandoned the colony due to the [[Species/Legends|species]] love of spacefaring.
